title: SGL-Curvature-MCMC: pipeline for cosmic-curvature inference from strong lensing with full SN covariance propagation
description: Numerical pipeline accompanying Hu & Liu (2026): the MILP-based SGL-SN matching engine (CosmoMatcher), covariance-reconstruction scripts, and MCMC sampling codes for joint inference of the cosmic curvature and the lens density-slope evolution. Associated manuscript: AAS76952.
